title: Staged policy enforcer for automated Optimize suggestions
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Customers want Optimize to auto-apply batching/caching suggestions to reduce unit costs, but teams require strong safety guarantees (no regressions in latency/quality, auditable approvals, and fast rollback). Goal: Implement a staged policy enforcer that can safely auto-apply Optimize suggestions using gated rollouts, canary policies, and approval workflows integrated into Console and the control plane. The enforcer should support shadow testing, gradual traffic shift, automatic rollback triggers based on observable regressions, and clear audit trails for compliance.
acceptance_criteria: Policy enforcer service accepts an Optimize suggestion payload and evaluates configured guardrails before enqueueing a rollout
Canary deployment mode can be initiated with a traffic split (e.g., 1% -> 10% -> 50%) and a shadow-only option for 0% traffic with metrics collection
Automatic rollback occurs if any configured metric threshold is breached for 3 consecutive evaluation windows
Manual approval flow available in Console with audit log entry recording approver, timestamp, and diff of changes
Audit trail stored in customer-visible logs for Private/Dedicated and in the control plane for Hosted, containing change-set, policy decisions, and metrics observed
End-to-end tests validate canary rollout, metric failure detection, and rollback without impacting non-canary requests
implementation_plan: Design policy schema for Optimize suggestions (conditions, metric thresholds, rollout plan, approvals) - API v1
Build enforcer microservice: evaluation engine, rollout orchestrator, canary agent, and audit logger
Integrate metrics collector with Console Metrics API and the runtime tracing hooks to collect latency, token rate, error rate, and quality eval signals
Add Console UI components: 'Preview change', 'Start canary', 'Request approval', and 'Force rollback' actions
Wire RBAC checks and make approval flow honor enterprise SSO/SAML groups
Add feature flags for safe ramp testing and an admin kill-switch for emergency rollbacks
testing_plan: Unit tests for policy evaluation logic and threshold comparisons
Staging e2e: create synthetic Optimize suggestions and run canary rollouts against a staging runtime with controlled perf regressions
Chaos test: simulate node failures and increased latency during canary to validate rollback triggers
Quality regression test: use a canary corpus and automated eval harness to detect generation quality drop > 3%
Performance test: validate that canary traffic routing adds <2ms median latency overhead to control plane operations
Security review and penetration test for the enforcer service (because it alters runtime configs)
rollout_strategy: Phase 0 - Shadow only: suggestions applied in shadow with no user traffic for 24h and metrics collected
Phase 1 - Micro-canary: 1% traffic for 2h -> evaluate metrics
Phase 2 - Gradual increase: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over configured intervals if metrics stable
Phase 3 - Full apply: 100% traffic or convert to recommended config after manual or automatic approval
Each phase requires metric checks (latency p95, error rate, token cost, eval quality) and can be gated by manual approver if policy demands
monitoring_and_rollback: Primary metrics: p95 latency, request error rate (4xx/5xx), token-per-request cost, custom eval score delta
Threshold defaults: p95 increase > 20% OR error rate increase > 1% absolute OR eval score drop > 3% => fail
Rollback policy: stop traffic migration and revert config if a threshold is breached for 3 consecutive collection windows (window=5m)
Escalation: send alerts to oncall, open a rollback PR if auto-rollback failed, and mark rollout as 'Failed' in Console
Observability: link rollout timeline to token-level cost breakdowns and request traces for fast RCA
notes: Trade-offs: stricter thresholds reduce risk but delay realized savings; configurable per-customer policy recommended
We will prioritize Hosted API first, then Dedicated, then Private because of central metrics availability; Private will support an on-prem audit sink integration
Backwards compatibility: if a customer pins model/version, enforcer must respect pin and only apply optimizations within allowed parameter ranges
Need legal/infosec signoff for automatic config changes in enterprise orgs (hence security_review_required=true)
